body: Run GGUF models easily with a KoboldAI UI. One File. Zero Install.
plain_description: Run powerful AI models locally on your own computer with zero installation. KoboldCpp bundles everything into a single file that works on Windows, Mac, and Linux — just download and run. It handles text generation, image creation, speech recognition, and more, all without needing an internet connection or cloud subscription.
technical_description: KoboldCpp is a self-contained AI inference server built on llama.cpp, supporting GGML and GGUF model formats for LLM text generation. It provides multiple API endpoints including a KoboldAI-compatible API, an OpenAI-compatible API at /v1, and additional endpoints for image generation (Stable Diffusion 1.5, SDXL, SD3, Flux), speech-to-text (Whisper), text-to-speech (Qwen3TTS, Kokoro, OuteTTS), and video generation (WAN 2.2). The single-file executable bundles all dependencies and runs on CPU with optional GPU offloading via CUDA, Vulkan, Metal, or HIPBLAS. It includes a bundled KoboldAI Lite web UI with chat, adventure, instruct, and storywriter modes, MCP server support, tool calling, RAG via TextDB, and Tavern character card loading.
title: koboldcpp
